intent.proves: At least one visible Product Catalog app renders a facet group.
intent.scope: active eCom_ProductCatalog paragraphs on active pages with a FacetGroups setting

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName = 'eCom_ProductCatalog' AND p.ParagraphModuleSettings LIKE '%<FacetGroups>/Files/%'
